html:
G'oya

Sanadan yil va oyni ajratib, shu matn bo'yicha guruhlaymiz. Oyning o'zi yetmaydi: 2023-05 va 2024-05 ikki xil oy. Sana funksiyalari dialektga bog'liq, lekin ikkala bazada bir xil ishlaydigan yo'l ham bor.

Yechim

SELECT SUBSTR(CAST(sale_date AS TEXT), 1, 7) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM sales
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(sale_date AS TEXT), 1, 7)

Sana matnga aylanganda 2024-03-15 ko'rinishida bo'ladi, uning birinchi 7 ta belgisi aynan 2024-03. Namunada martga 15- va 31-martdagi savdolar tushadi: jami 230 000.

Tuzoqlar

Faqat oy raqami bo'yicha guruhlash. Har xil yillarning bir xil oylari bitta guruhga qo'shilib ketadi, natijada esa yil umuman ko'rinmaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT SUBSTR(CAST(sale_date AS TEXT), 6, 2) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM sales
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(sale_date AS TEXT), 6, 2)

PostgreSQL'dagi EXTRACT(MONTH FROM sale_date) ham xuddi shu xatoga olib keladi. SUM o'rniga COUNT(*) yozib qo'ymang: savdolar soni emas, summasi kerak.

Dialektlar farqi

Sana funksiyalari bilan ham yozsa bo'ladi, faqat har bir dialektda o'zinikini. PostgreSQL'da TO_CHAR:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT TO_CHAR(sale_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM sales
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(sale_date, 'YYYY-MM')

SQLite'da strftime:

Faqat SQLiteSELECT strftime('%Y-%m', sale_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM sales
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', sale_date)

TO_CHAR ni SQLite bilmaydi, strftime ni esa PostgreSQL.
